notes:
- Added new "Appearance" category, containing a button to change character appearance
- Added new "Combat" category to cover settings being moved over from Fix Target Lock after the major update on Sept. 30
- Added setting to enable quick-cast, allowing casting ground-targeted skills with a single button press instead of two. Hold the skill button to aim, release to cast.
- Added "Disable target lock camera movement", which allows camera free-look while locked onto a target.

* Fixed an issue where symlinks didn't work as downloaded dependencies.
